answer: Rare-fingerprint collision audit. After payouts, sample each identity’s outputs for rare artifacts—error strings, build-host IDs, cache keys—and compute pairwise collision rates against a background model. Over a 90-day horizon, clusters with overlap beyond chance are frozen and clawed back. A shared deployment jetty leaves correlated build-ID fragments, so reuse is detectable. Each extra identity needs a separate build host, rotated external accounts, and scrubbed quirks, including dune-specific asset hashes, costing roughly $20 monthly plus setup.
